title: Kickoff menu not centering on the screen horizontally when centered on the panel and it *could* be centered within existing constraints
line: A launcher or other widget placed near the middle of a panel now opens its popup centered on the panel, as long as the popup still covers its button.
explanation: PopupPlasmaWindow anchors every applet popup on the rectangle of the item that opened it, so with Kickoff centered among spacers and a few task icons the menu was centered on the Kickoff button, a bit left of the panel's middle, even though a centered menu would still sit over the button. The popup's anchor rectangle is now moved to the center of its panel (along the panel's direction only) when the item comes from a panel and a popup centered there would still fully cover the item; otherwise nothing changes.

commits.message:
popupplasmawindow: center panel popups when they still cover their button

Applet popups were always centered on the item that opened them, so a
launcher placed near the middle of a panel opened off center. Now the
popup snaps to the panel's center when it would still cover that item.

BUG: 499472

media.caption: Master: Kickoff between spacers at x 507 on a top panel; the menu is centered on the button (x 180-835) instead of the panel
With the fix: same panel, the menu is centered on the panel (x 312-967) and still covers the button

reviews.text: The root cause, libplasma layer, and panel-axis coverage check are sound and cleanly fix centered panel launchers like Kickoff opening off-center. However, applying this snapping unconditionally inside PopupPlasmaWindowPrivate::updatePosition() affects all PopupPlasmaWindow subclasses—including ToolTipDialog (panel and Task Manager hover tooltips) and GroupDialog—which will cause hover tooltips near the center of a panel to stick at the panel center across multiple icons or jump away from the hovered icon, contradicting the commit message's own scope of 'Applet popups'.
changes: Scope the panel-center snapping to applet popups (e.g. via an opt-in flag/property on PopupPlasmaWindow enabled by AppletPopup, or restricting it to AppletPopup) so ToolTipDialog hover tooltips and Task Manager GroupDialog popups remain anchored over their visual parent item.
Verify as a regression check that hovering Task Manager icons near the center of a panel keeps tooltips centered over each hovered icon rather than snapping them to the panel center.

reviews.text: The placement rule is right for what the reporter asked (center on the panel when the popup still fully covers the button, snapping only along the panel axis), and the after screenshot shows Kickoff centered at 640 over its button. But the change sits in PopupPlasmaWindowPrivate::updatePosition and is gated only on the visual parent's window being a panel ContainmentView, so it also affects every other PopupPlasmaWindow opened from a panel. That includes ToolTipDialog (all panel tooltips, task manager thumbnail tooltips among them) and the task manager's GroupDialog. With a centered dock, or even the default bottom panel where tasks span the middle, a tooltip for a task near the center would no longer sit over the hovered item: it would stay pinned at the panel center while you hover across neighbouring icons, then jump. None of the regression checks cover tooltips or group popups.
changes: Limit the snap to applet expanded popups (e.g. only when q is a PlasmaQuick::AppletPopup, or behind an opt-in property that AppletPopup sets), so ToolTipDialog and other PopupPlasmaWindows keep centering on their visual parent.
Add regression checks for task manager tooltips and the grouped-task popup for tasks near the center of a centered/full-width panel, showing they still center on the hovered item.
